rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि

rows.en: You are not alone
rows.ne: तपाईं एक्लो हुनुहुन्न

rows.en: Many people feel this way after a distressing experience.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि धेरै मानिसलाई यस्तै महसुस हुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing experience, many people feel like this.

rows.en: A distressing experience can change how we feel, think, sleep and get along with others. These are common reactions. People react in different ways, and there is no right or wrong way to feel. Support can help, and you do not have to wait to ask for it.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवले हामी कस्तो महसुस गर्छौं, कसरी सोच्छौं, कसरी सुत्छौं र अरूसँग कसरी व्यवहार गर्छौं भन्ने कुरामा परिवर्तन ल्याउन सक्छ । यी सामान्य प्रतिक्रियाहरू हुन् । मानिसहरूको प्रतिक्रिया फरक-फरक हुन्छ, र महसुस गर्ने कुनै सही वा गलत तरिका हुँदैन । सहयोगले मद्दत गर्न सक्छ, र सहयोग माग्न तपाईंले पर्खिनु पर्दैन ।

rows.en: Small things that can help
rows.ne: सहयोग गर्न सक्ने साना कुराहरू

rows.en: Be with someone you trust
rows.ne: विश्वासिलो मानिससँग बस्नुहोस्

rows.en: Talk, or simply sit together quietly. You do not have to tell your story.
rows.ne: कुरा गर्नुहोस्, वा चुपचाप सँगै बस्नुहोस् । तपाईंले आफ्नो कथा सुनाउनै पर्छ भन्ने छैन ।

rows.en: Rest, eat and drink safe water
rows.ne: आराम, खाना र सुरक्षित पानी

rows.en: Rest when you can. Eat regular meals if you can, and drink safe water.
rows.ne: सकेसम्म आराम गर्नुहोस् । सम्भव भए नियमित रूपमा खाना खानुहोस्, र सुरक्षित पानी पिउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: If there is still danger, follow local warnings. Stay away from unsafe places and damaged buildings.
rows.ne: अझै खतरा छ भने स्थानीय चेतावनी पालना गर्नुहोस् । असुरक्षित ठाउँ र क्षतिग्रस्त भवनबाट टाढा रहनुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If danger remains, follow local warnings. Stay far from unsafe places and damaged buildings.

rows.en: Want to read more? WHO's illustrated guide Doing What Matters in Times of Stress is available in Nepali.
rows.ne: थप पढ्न चाहनुहुन्छ? विश्व स्वास्थ्य संगठन (WHO) को चित्रसहितको पुस्तिका Doing What Matters in Times of Stress नेपालीमा उपलब्ध छ ।

rows.en: Breathe slowly
rows.ne: बिस्तारै सास फेर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Breathe in slowly, then breathe out slowly.
rows.ne: बिस्तारै सास भित्र लिनुहोस्, अनि बिस्तारै बाहिर फाल्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Take breath in slowly, then let it out slowly.

rows.en: Notice three things you can see and hear around you.
rows.ne: वरिपरि देख्न र सुन्न सकिने तीनवटा कुरामा ध्यान दिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Pay attention to three things around you that can be seen and heard.

rows.en: Stop if it makes you feel worse.
rows.ne: यसले झन् नराम्रो महसुस गराएमा रोक्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): If it makes you feel worse, stop.

rows.en: Do one small task
rows.ne: एउटा सानो काम गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Choose one thing you can manage today. Take breaks; you do not have to do everything at once.
rows.ne: आज गर्न सक्ने एउटा काम छान्नुहोस् । बीच-बीचमा आराम गर्नुहोस्; सबै काम एकैपटक गर्नुपर्दैन ।

rows.en: Keep daily routines
rows.ne: दैनिक दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Regular times for meals, sleep and play help children and adults feel safer.
rows.ne: खाना, निद्रा र खेलका लागि नियमित समय हुँदा बालबालिका र वयस्क दुवैलाई बढी सुरक्षित महसुस हुन्छ ।

rows.en: If you take medicine from a doctor, do not stop it without asking a health worker.
rows.ne: डाक्टरले दिएको औषधि खाँदै हुनुहुन्छ भने, स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई नसोधी नछाड्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If you are taking medicine a doctor gave, do not stop without asking a health worker.

rows.en: Ways of coping that can make things worse
rows.ne: अवस्था झन् बिगार्न सक्ने सामना गर्ने तरिकाहरू

rows.en: Your feelings are not wrong. But some ways of coping can harm you or the people around you:
rows.ne: तपाईंका भावनाहरू गलत होइनन् । तर सामना गर्ने केही तरिकाले तपाईं वा तपाईंका वरिपरिका मानिसलाई हानि पुर्‍याउन सक्छन्:

rows.en: Drinking alcohol or using drugs to forget or to sleep
rows.ne: बिर्सन वा निदाउन रक्सी पिउने वा लागूपदार्थ प्रयोग गर्ने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Drinking alcohol or using drugs to forget or to fall asleep

rows.en: Staying away from everyone for a long time
rows.ne: लामो समयसम्म सबैबाट टाढा बस्ने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Staying far from everyone for a long time

rows.en: Taking anger out on others, especially children
rows.ne: आफ्नो रिस अरूमाथि, विशेष गरी बालबालिकामाथि पोख्ने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Pouring out one's anger on others, especially on children

rows.en: Working all day without any rest
rows.ne: कुनै आराम नगरी दिनभर काम गरिरहने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Working all day without taking any rest

rows.en: If you notice these in yourself or someone close to you, talk to someone you trust or a health worker.
rows.ne: आफूमा वा आफ्नो नजिकको कसैमा यस्ता कुरा देखिए, आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिस वा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If such things are seen in yourself or someone close, talk with a person you trust or a health worker.

rows.en: You may notice
rows.ne: तपाईंमा यस्ता कुरा देखिन सक्छन्

rows.en: Sadness, worry, fear, anger, or feeling numb
rows.ne: दुःख, चिन्ता, डर, रिस, वा केही पनि महसुस नहुने

rows.en: Feeling very tired, aches and pains, headaches. If pain, fever or another body problem worries you, see a health worker.
rows.ne: धेरै थकाइ लाग्ने, जीउ दुख्ने, टाउको दुख्ने । दुखाइ, ज्वरो वा शरीरको अरू कुनै समस्याले चिन्तित बनाएमा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई भेट्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Feeling very tired, body aches, headaches. If pain, fever or another body problem makes you worried, meet a health worker.

rows.en: Trouble falling asleep, or bad dreams
rows.ne: निदाउन गाह्रो हुने, वा नराम्रा सपना देख्ने

rows.en: Upsetting memories that come back, or trouble concentrating
rows.ne: नरमाइला सम्झनाहरू फेरि-फेरि आउने, वा ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्न गाह्रो हुने

rows.en: Feeling irritable, or wanting to be alone
rows.ne: झर्को लाग्ने, वा एक्लै बस्न मन लाग्ने

rows.en: Children react too
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा पनि प्रतिक्रिया देखिन्छ

rows.en: They may cling to you, cry more, or become very quiet. Stay close, explain simply what is happening, and keep familiar routines.
rows.ne: उनीहरू तपाईंसँग टाँसिइरहन सक्छन्, धेरै रुन सक्छन्, वा एकदमै चुपचाप हुन सक्छन् । उनीहरूको नजिकै रहनुहोस्, के भइरहेको छ भनेर सरल रूपमा बुझाउनुहोस्, र परिचित दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Feelings getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंका भावना झन् गाह्रा हुँदैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are your feelings becoming more difficult, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Sources: WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO, Doing What Matters in Times of Stress (2020); IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015). This material draws on these publications; it was not created by WHO or IASC, which are not responsible for its content.

rows.en: It can be hard to sleep after a distressing experience
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि निदाउन गाह्रो हुन सक्छ
rows.note: Series term "distressing experience" = पीडादायी अनुभव (see Terms). No full stop in titles.

rows.en: After a flood, an earthquake or another distressing experience, many people sleep badly or wake up afraid. You are not alone.
rows.ne: बाढी, भूकम्प वा अरू कुनै पीडादायी अनुभवपछि धेरै मानिसलाई राम्रोसँग निद्रा लाग्दैन, वा उनीहरू डराएर ब्यूँझन्छन् । तपाईं एक्लो हुनुहुन्न ।

rows.en: Before night
rows.ne: राति सुत्नुअघि

rows.en: If there is still a risk, check local warnings.
rows.note: Condition first: यदि … भने. Same meaning as the safety line.

rows.en: Keep a torch nearby
rows.ne: टर्च नजिकै राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: If you wake up afraid
rows.ne: डराएर ब्यूँझनुभयो भने

rows.en: Notice the safe things around you
rows.ne: आफ्नो वरिपरिका सुरक्षित कुराहरूमा ध्यान दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Breathe slowly
rows.ne: बिस्तारै सास फेर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Go to someone you trust
rows.ne: विश्वासिलो मानिसकहाँ जानुहोस्
rows.note: Short label form, as C1P-09. Longer option: आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसकहाँ जानुहोस्.

ch2.title: Chapter 2 · Difficult nights · Leaflet A4 tri-fold
ch2.source: Approved English leaflet r5 (exact text of the online and print versions) · Nepali machine draft r2, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: It can be hard to sleep after a distressing experience
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि निदाउन गाह्रो हुन सक्छ

rows.en: After a distressing experience, many people find it hard to sleep. Some wake up afraid, have bad dreams, or lie awake on alert. This is a common reaction. Support can help, and you do not have to wait to ask for it.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि धेरै मानिसलाई निदाउन गाह्रो हुन्छ । कोही डराएर ब्यूँझन्छन्, नराम्रा सपना देख्छन्, वा सतर्क भएर जागै बस्छन् । यो सामान्य प्रतिक्रिया हो । सहयोगले मद्दत गर्न सक्छ, र सहयोग माग्न तपाईंले पर्खिनु पर्दैन ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing experience many people find it hard to fall asleep. Some wake up afraid, see bad dreams, or stay awake on alert. This is a common reaction. Help can help, and you need not wait to ask for help.

rows.en: Before night
rows.ne: राति सुत्नुअघि

rows.en: Know the plan.
rows.ne: योजना थाहा पाउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Check local warnings and know where to go if one comes. Knowing the plan can make it easier to rest.
rows.ne: स्थानीय चेतावनी हेर्नुहोस्, र चेतावनी आएमा कहाँ जाने भनेर थाहा पाउनुहोस् । योजना थाहा हुँदा आराम गर्न सजिलो हुन सक्छ ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Look at local warnings, and know where to go if a warning comes. Knowing the plan can make resting easier.

rows.en: Keep what you need close.
rows.ne: चाहिने कुरा नजिकै राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: A torch, some water, and any medicine you take.
rows.ne: टर्च, अलिकति पानी, र तपाईंले खाने कुनै पनि औषधि ।

rows.en: Agree on quiet times.
rows.ne: शान्त समय तय गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: In a shared room, agree with the people around you when lights go off and voices go down, if you can.
rows.ne: साझा कोठामा, सम्भव भए, बत्ती कहिले निभाउने र कहिलेदेखि बिस्तारै बोल्ने भनेर वरिपरिका मानिससँग सहमति गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Wind down.
rows.ne: सुत्नुअघि मन शान्त पार्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: A familiar habit before sleep, such as a song, a story or a quiet talk, can help.
rows.ne: सुत्नुअघिको कुनै परिचित बानी, जस्तै गीत, कथा वा शान्त कुराकानीले मद्दत गर्न सक्छ ।

rows.en: If you wake up afraid
rows.ne: डराएर ब्यूँझनुभयो भने

rows.en: Notice where you are.
rows.ne: आफू कहाँ हुनुहुन्छ, हेर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Look around and name a few things you can see and hear now.
rows.ne: वरिपरि हेर्नुहोस्, र अहिले देख्न र सुन्न सकिने केही कुराको नाम लिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Breathe slowly.
rows.ne: बिस्तारै सास फेर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Breathe in slowly, then breathe out slowly. Stop if it makes you feel worse.
rows.ne: बिस्तारै सास भित्र लिनुहोस्, अनि बिस्तारै बाहिर फाल्नुहोस् । यसले झन् नराम्रो महसुस गराएमा रोक्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Go to someone you trust.
rows.ne: विश्वासिलो मानिसकहाँ जानुहोस् ।

rows.en: Sit with them, or let them know you are awake. You do not have to talk about it.
rows.ne: उहाँसँग बस्नुहोस्, वा आफू जागै छु भनेर उहाँलाई थाहा दिनुहोस् । यसबारे कुरा गर्नैपर्छ भन्ने छैन ।

rows.en: If you take medicine from a doctor, do not stop it without asking a health worker.
rows.ne: डाक्टरले दिएको औषधि खाँदै हुनुहुन्छ भने, स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई नसोधी नछाड्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If you are taking medicine a doctor gave, do not stop without asking a health worker.

rows.en: Things that can make sleep worse
rows.ne: निद्रा झन् बिगार्न सक्ने कुराहरू

rows.en: Drinking alcohol or using drugs to sleep
rows.ne: निदाउन रक्सी पिउने वा लागूपदार्थ प्रयोग गर्ने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Drinking alcohol or using drugs to fall asleep

rows.en: Taking sleeping medicine that a health worker did not give you
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यकर्मीले नदिएको निद्राको औषधि खाने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Taking sleep medicine that a health worker did not give

rows.en: Lying awake for a long time going over worries: get up, sit quietly, and try again later
rows.ne: चिन्ताबारे सोच्दै लामो समय जागै पल्टिरहनु: उठ्नुहोस्, शान्तसँग बस्नुहोस्, र केही बेरपछि फेरि सुत्ने प्रयास गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: If there is still danger, follow local warnings. Stay away from unsafe places and damaged buildings.
rows.ne: अझै खतरा छ भने स्थानीय चेतावनी पालना गर्नुहोस् । असुरक्षित ठाउँ र क्षतिग्रस्त भवनबाट टाढा रहनुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If danger remains, follow local warnings. Stay far from unsafe places and damaged buildings.

rows.en: When to ask for help
rows.ne: कहिले सहयोग माग्ने

rows.en: If poor sleep goes on and makes your days hard, or you feel very worried about it, talk to a health worker.
rows.ne: निद्राको समस्या लम्बिएर दिनहरू गाह्रो बनाएमा, वा यसबारे धेरै चिन्ता लागेमा, स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If the sleep problem goes on and makes the days hard, or you feel much worry about it, talk with a health worker.

rows.en: Children at night
rows.ne: रातमा बालबालिका

rows.en: Children may be afraid of the dark, want to sleep close to you, or start wetting the bed again.
rows.ne: बालबालिका अँध्यारोसँग डराउन सक्छन्, तपाईंकै नजिक सुत्न चाहन सक्छन्, वा फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्न थाल्न सक्छन् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Children may fear the dark, may want to sleep close to you, or may start wetting the bed again.

rows.en: Let them stay close.
rows.ne: उनीहरूलाई नजिकै बस्न दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Keep a short bedtime routine, such as a story or a song.
rows.ne: सुत्ने बेलाको छोटो दिनचर्या राख्नुहोस्, जस्तै कथा वा गीत ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Keep a short bedtime routine, like a story or song.

rows.en: Tell them simply what the family will do if a warning comes.
rows.ne: चेतावनी आएमा परिवारले के गर्छ भनेर सरल शब्दमा बताउनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Tell in simple words what the family does if a warning comes.

rows.en: Do not punish a child for waking up or wetting the bed.
rows.ne: ब्यूँझिएकोमा वा ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेरेकोमा बच्चालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Do not punish the child for waking or wetting the bed.

rows.en: During the day
rows.ne: दिनमा

rows.en: Get up and eat at regular times if you can, and spend some time in daylight. For more tips on healthy sleep, see the leaflet Healthy sleep (CMC-Nepal).
rows.ne: सम्भव भए नियमित समयमा उठ्नुहोस् र खाना खानुहोस्, अनि केही समय दिउँसोको उज्यालोमा बिताउनुहोस् । स्वस्थ निद्राबारे थप सुझावका लागि सीएमसी-नेपालको पर्चा "स्वस्थ निद्रा" हेर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Feelings getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंका भावना झन् गाह्रा हुँदैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are your feelings becoming more difficult, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Sources: WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015); WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); IFRC Psychosocial Centre, Mental health and psychosocial impacts of flooding.
rows.ne: स्रोतहरू: WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); WHO/UNHCR, mhGAP Humanitarian Intervention Guide (2015); WHO and UNICEF, Helping children cope with stress (2020); IFRC Psychosocial Centre, Mental health and psychosocial impacts of flooding ।

ch3.title: Chapter 3 · Grief · Leaflet A4 tri-fold
ch3.source: Approved English leaflet r6 (exact text of the online and print versions) · Nepali machine draft r1, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: WHEN SOMEONE WE LOVE HAS DIED OR IS MISSING
rows.ne: आफूले माया गर्ने कसैको मृत्यु भएको वा उहाँ बेपत्ता भएको बेला
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): When someone we love has died or is missing.

rows.en: There is no right way to grieve
rows.ne: शोक गर्ने कुनै एउटै सही तरिका हुँदैन

rows.en: Grief is a normal response when someone we love has died or is missing. There is no right way to grieve, and no set time when it should end. People grieve in different ways.
rows.ne: हामीले माया गर्ने कसैको मृत्यु हुँदा वा उहाँ बेपत्ता हुँदा शोक लाग्नु सामान्य प्रतिक्रिया हो । शोक गर्ने कुनै एउटै सही तरिका हुँदैन, र यो कहिले सकिनुपर्छ भन्ने कुनै तोकिएको समय पनि हुँदैन । मानिसहरू फरक-फरक तरिकाले शोक गर्छन् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Feeling grief when someone we love dies or goes missing is a normal reaction. There is no single right way to grieve, and no fixed time when it must end. People grieve in different ways.

rows.en: Looking after yourself
rows.ne: आफ्नो हेरचाह

rows.en: Rest when you can.
rows.ne: सकेसम्म आराम गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Rest as much as possible.

rows.en: Eat, and drink safe water.
rows.ne: खाना खानुहोस्, र सुरक्षित पानी पिउनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Eat food, and drink safe water.

rows.en: Spend time with people you trust.
rows.ne: आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिससँग समय बिताउनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Spend time with people you trust.

rows.en: You can talk about the person, or not.
rows.ne: उहाँको बारेमा कुरा गर्न पनि सक्नुहुन्छ, नगर्न पनि ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): You can talk about him/her, or not.

rows.en: Remember the person in your own way, if you wish.
rows.ne: चाहनुहुन्छ भने उहाँलाई आफ्नै तरिकाले सम्झनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Do one small task at a time.
rows.ne: एकपटकमा एउटा सानो काम गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Children grieve too
rows.ne: बालबालिका पनि शोक गर्छन्

rows.en: Answer their questions honestly, in simple words.
rows.ne: उनीहरूका प्रश्नको इमानदारीपूर्वक, सरल शब्दमा जवाफ दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Stay close and keep familiar routines.
rows.ne: नजिकै रहनुहोस् र परिचित दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Let them share memories of the person, if they wish,
rows.ne: उनीहरू चाहन्छन् भने, त्यो व्यक्तिका सम्झना बाँड्न दिनुहोस्,
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): If they want, let them share memories of that person,

rows.en: for example through drawing or stories.
rows.ne: जस्तै चित्र कोरेर वा कथा सुनाएर ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): for example by drawing or telling stories.

rows.en: If you are helping someone who is grieving
rows.ne: शोकमा परेका कसैलाई सहयोग गर्दै हुनुहुन्छ भने

rows.en: Stay close.
rows.ne: नजिकै रहनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Listen, or sit quietly.
rows.ne: सुन्नुहोस्, वा चुपचाप सँगै बस्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Listen, or sit quietly together.

rows.en: Ask what would help today,
rows.ne: आज केले सहयोग पुग्छ भनेर सोध्नुहोस्,
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Ask what would help today,

rows.en: for example bringing food, collecting water or helping with a daily task, if they want it.
rows.ne: जस्तै खाना ल्याइदिने, पानी भरिदिने वा दैनिक काममा सघाउने, यदि उहाँ चाहनुहुन्छ भने ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): for example bringing food, fetching water or helping with daily work, if he/she wants.

rows.en: Avoid saying “be strong”, comparing losses, or telling them when they should feel better.
rows.ne: “बलियो हुनुहोस्” भन्ने, कसको क्षति ठूलो भनेर तुलना गर्ने, वा उहाँ कहिलेसम्म ठीक हुनुपर्छ भनेर भन्ने कुराबाट जोगिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Avoid saying "be strong", comparing whose loss is bigger, or saying by when he/she should be well.

rows.en: When to ask for help
rows.ne: कहिले सहयोग माग्ने

rows.en: If grief makes it very hard to eat, sleep or care for yourself or others for a long time, or you want support at any time, talk to a health worker.
rows.ne: शोकका कारण लामो समयसम्म खान, सुत्न वा आफ्नो वा अरूको हेरचाह गर्न धेरै गाह्रो भएमा, वा जुनसुकै बेला सहयोग चाहिएमा, स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If because of grief eating, sleeping or caring for yourself or others is very hard for a long time, or if you need support at any time, talk with a health worker.

rows.en: You may notice
rows.ne: तपाईंमा यस्ता कुरा देखिन सक्छन्

rows.en: Sadness, crying, anger, guilt, or feeling empty
rows.ne: दुःख, रुनु, रिस, आफूलाई दोषी ठान्नु, वा मन खाली-खाली लाग्नु

rows.en: Thinking about the person often, or longing for them
rows.ne: उहाँको बारेमा बारम्बार सोच्नु, वा उहाँलाई भेट्ने तीव्र चाहना हुनु

rows.en: Feeling very tired, or trouble sleeping and eating
rows.ne: धेरै थकाइ लाग्नु, वा निदाउन र खाना खान गाह्रो हुनु

rows.en: Wanting to be with people, or wanting to be alone
rows.ne: मानिसहरूसँग बस्न मन लाग्नु, वा एक्लै बस्न मन लाग्नु

rows.en: When a loved one is missing
rows.ne: प्रिय व्यक्ति बेपत्ता हुँदा
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): When a dear person is missing

rows.en: You may hope and grieve at the same time. Both are natural. For information, contact ____________ (tracing contact, filled in and checked locally). You can ask for support while you wait.
rows.ne: तपाईंलाई एकै समयमा आशा र शोक दुवै हुन सक्छ । दुवै स्वाभाविक हुन् । जानकारीका लागि ____________ (खोजी सम्पर्क, स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको) मा सम्पर्क गर्नुहोस् । पर्खिँदै गर्दा पनि तपाईं सहयोग माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): You may have hope and grief both at once. Both are natural. For information contact ____ (tracing contact, filled in and checked locally). Even while waiting you can ask for support.

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Grief has no fixed end date. If you want support, or grief is making daily life hard, talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: शोक कहिले सकिनुपर्छ भन्ने निश्चित समय हुँदैन । तपाईं सहयोग चाहनुहुन्छ वा शोकले दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेको छ भने स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): There is no fixed time by which grief must end. If you want support or grief makes daily life difficult, talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि

rows.en: Children react too
rows.ne: बालबालिकामा पनि प्रतिक्रिया देखिन्छ

rows.en: Children feel a distressing experience too, even when they do not talk about it. Changes in how they behave are common afterwards. Your love and attention help them feel safe.
rows.ne: बालबालिकाले कुरा नगरे पनि पीडादायी अनुभवको असर उनीहरूमा पनि पर्छ । त्यसपछि उनीहरूको व्यवहारमा परिवर्तन आउनु सामान्य हो । तपाईंको माया र ध्यानले उनीहरूलाई सुरक्षित महसुस गराउँछ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Even if children do not talk, a distressing experience affects them too. Afterwards, change in their behaviour is common. Your love and attention make them feel safe.

rows.en: What helps
rows.ne: केले सहयोग गर्छ

rows.en: Stay close
rows.ne: नजिकै रहनुहोस्

rows.en: Keep children with their family whenever possible. If you must be apart, tell them when you will be back.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएसम्म बालबालिकालाई परिवारसँगै राख्नुहोस् । छुट्टिनै पर्ने भए, कहिले फर्कनुहुन्छ भनेर उनीहरूलाई बताउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Explain simply
rows.ne: सरल रूपमा बताउनुहोस्

rows.en: Tell them what happened and what is happening now, in words they understand. It is all right to say “I don’t know yet”.
rows.ne: के भयो र अहिले के भइरहेको छ, उनीहरूले बुझ्ने शब्दमा बताउनुहोस् । "मलाई अझै थाहा छैन" भन्नु पनि ठीकै हो ।

rows.en: Give extra time
rows.ne: थप समय दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Listen, speak kindly, and give more time and affection.
rows.ne: सुन्नुहोस्, मायालु तरिकाले बोल्नुहोस्, र थप समय र माया दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Keep routines
rows.ne: दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Regular times for meals, sleep and play, even in a new place. Make new routines if the old ones are not possible.
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा पनि खाना, निद्रा र खेलका लागि नियमित समय राख्नुहोस् । पुरानो दिनचर्या सम्भव नभए नयाँ दिनचर्या बनाउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Make time for safe play
rows.ne: सुरक्षित खेलका लागि समय दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Play, drawing and songs help children feel safer and express feelings.
rows.ne: खेल, चित्र कोर्ने र गीत गाउने कुराले बालबालिकालाई बढी सुरक्षित महसुस गर्न र आफ्ना भावना व्यक्त गर्न मद्दत गर्छ ।

rows.en: Talking about loss
rows.ne: क्षतिबारे कुरा गर्दा
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): When talking about loss

rows.en: If someone has died or is missing, answer questions honestly and simply. Children may ask the same question many times. Let them share memories, through drawing or stories, if they wish.
rows.ne: कसैको मृत्यु भएको वा कोही बेपत्ता भएको छ भने, उनीहरूका प्रश्नको इमानदारीपूर्वक र सरल जवाफ दिनुहोस् । बालबालिकाले एउटै प्रश्न धेरैपटक सोध्न सक्छन् । उनीहरू चाहन्छन् भने, चित्र कोरेर वा कथा सुनाएर सम्झना बाँड्न दिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): If someone has died or is missing, answer their questions honestly and simply. Children may ask the same question many times. If they want, let them share memories by drawing or telling stories.

rows.en: My Hero is You, a story book for children aged 6 to 11, is available in Nepali.
rows.ne: ६ देखि ११ वर्षका बालबालिकाका लागि कथा पुस्तक My Hero is You नेपालीमा पनि उपलब्ध छ ।

rows.en: Look after yourself too
rows.ne: आफ्नो पनि ख्याल राख्नुहोस्

rows.en: Caring for children after a distressing experience is hard. Take a short pause when you feel angry or tired: breathe, then respond. Ask family or neighbours to share care.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि बालबालिकाको हेरचाह गर्नु गाह्रो हुन्छ । रिस उठेको वा थकाइ लागेको बेला एकछिन रोकिनुहोस्: सास फेर्नुहोस्, अनि मात्र प्रतिक्रिया दिनुहोस् । हेरचाहमा सघाउन परिवार वा छिमेकीलाई अनुरोध गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): After a distressing experience caring for children is hard. When angry or tired, pause a moment: breathe, then respond. Ask family or neighbours to help with care.

rows.en: Do not punish a child for being afraid, wetting the bed or behaving differently.
rows.ne: डराएकोमा, ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेरेकोमा वा फरक व्यवहार गरेकोमा बच्चालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Do not punish a child for being afraid, wetting the bed or behaving differently.

rows.en: Do not leave children alone with people you do not know.
rows.ne: बालबालिकालाई नचिनेका मानिससँग एक्लै नछोड्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Do not leave children alone with unknown people.

rows.en: When to ask for help
rows.ne: कहिले सहयोग माग्ने

rows.en: Talk to a health worker if changes in your child go on for a long time or get worse, if your child stops eating, playing or talking, or if your child talks about hurting themselves. If a child is alone, separated from their family, or at risk of harm, tell a responder or ____________ (child protection contact, filled in locally) straight away.
rows.ne: बच्चामा देखिएका परिवर्तन लामो समयसम्म रहिरहेमा वा झन् बढेमा, बच्चाले खान, खेल्न वा बोल्न छाडेमा, वा बच्चाले आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने कुरा गरेमा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । कुनै बच्चा एक्लै छ, परिवारबाट छुट्टिएको छ, वा हानिको जोखिममा छ भने तुरुन्तै उद्धारकर्मी वा ____________ (बाल संरक्षण सम्पर्क, स्थानीय रूपमा भरिने) लाई खबर गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Talk with a health worker if changes in the child stay a long time or grow worse, if the child stops eating, playing or speaking, or if the child talks of harming himself/herself. If a child is alone, separated from family, or at risk of harm, inform a responder or ____ (child protection contact, filled in locally) immediately.

rows.en: What you may notice
rows.ne: तपाईंले यस्तो देख्न सक्नुहुन्छ

rows.en: Young children
rows.ne: साना बालबालिका

rows.en: Clinging, crying more, wetting the bed again, trouble sleeping, or being afraid when you are out of sight
rows.ne: टाँसिइरहने, धेरै रुने, फेरि ओछ्यानमा पिसाब फेर्ने, निदाउन गाह्रो हुने, वा तपाईं नदेखिँदा डराउने

rows.en: Older children
rows.ne: अलि ठूला बालबालिका

rows.en: Being very quiet or very restless, getting angry easily, trouble concentrating, or playing out what happened again and again
rows.ne: एकदमै चुपचाप वा एकदमै चकचके हुने, सजिलै रिसाउने, ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्न गाह्रो हुने, वा भएको घटनालाई खेलमा बारम्बार दोहोर्‍याउने
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Being very quiet or very restless, getting angry easily, finding it hard to concentrate, or repeating what happened in play again and again

rows.en: Adolescents
rows.ne: किशोरकिशोरी

rows.en: Staying away from others, being irritable, worrying about the family, or taking risks
rows.ne: अरूबाट टाढा बस्ने, झर्को मान्ने, परिवारको चिन्ता गर्ने, वा जोखिमपूर्ण काम गर्ने

rows.en: Children with disabilities
rows.ne: अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिका

rows.en: Children with disabilities may need more time, clear routines and your help to join play. For more, see the leaflet for parents of children and adolescents with disabilities (CMC-Nepal).
rows.ne: अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिकालाई थप समय, स्पष्ट दिनचर्या र खेलमा सहभागी हुन तपाईंको सहयोग चाहिन सक्छ । थप जानकारीका लागि अपाङ्गता भएका बालबालिका र किशोरकिशोरीका अभिभावकका लागि सीएमसी-नेपालको पर्चा हेर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Changes in your child getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंको बच्चामा देखिएका परिवर्तन झन् बढ्दैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are changes seen in your child increasing, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Every family's next step is different
rows.ne: हरेक परिवारको अर्को कदम फरक हुन्छ

rows.en: Home is more than a house. Adjusting can take time.
rows.ne: घर भनेको भवन मात्र होइन । नयाँ अवस्थामा बानी पर्न समय लाग्न सक्छ ।

rows.en: Going home
rows.ne: घर फर्कंदै

rows.en: Return only when it is safe.
Moving somewhere new
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा सर्दै

rows.en: Give yourself time to settle.
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा भिज्न आफूलाई समय दिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Still waiting
rows.ne: अझै पर्खिँदै

rows.ne: बालबालिकाको दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस्

ch5.title: Chapter 5 · Every family's next step is different · Leaflet A4 tri-fold
ch5.source: Approved English leaflet r3 (exact text of the online and print versions) · Nepali machine draft r1, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: AFTER A DISTRESSING EXPERIENCE
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि

rows.en: Every family’s next step is different
rows.ne: हरेक परिवारको अर्को कदम फरक हुन्छ

rows.en: Some families are going home, some are moving somewhere new, and some are still waiting. You may feel relief, sadness, worry or anger, sometimes all at once. Even a familiar place may not feel the same.
rows.ne: केही परिवार घर फर्कंदैछन्, केही नयाँ ठाउँमा सर्दैछन्, र केही अझै पर्खिरहेका छन् । तपाईंलाई राहत, दुःख, चिन्ता वा रिस, कहिलेकाहीँ सबै एकैपटक, महसुस हुन सक्छ । परिचित ठाउँ पनि पहिलेजस्तो नलाग्न सक्छ ।

rows.en: Going home
rows.ne: घर फर्कंदै

rows.en: Before entering a damaged home, ask your ward office how to get a safety check of the house and land. If you are not sure it is safe, do not go in. Go with someone you trust, if you can.
rows.ne: क्षतिग्रस्त घरभित्र पस्नुअघि, घर र जग्गाको सुरक्षा जाँच कसरी गराउने भनेर आफ्नो वडा कार्यालयलाई सोध्नुहोस् । सुरक्षित छ कि छैन भन्ने निश्चित नभए भित्र नपस्नुहोस् । सकेसम्म आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिससँगै जानुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Before entering a damaged house, ask your ward office how to get a safety check of house and land. If not sure whether it is safe, do not go inside. If possible go together with a person you trust.

rows.en: Moving somewhere new
rows.ne: नयाँ ठाउँमा सर्दै

rows.en: You may miss your old home, even in a safe new place. Give yourself time. If it feels right, talk with the people you stay with about sharing space and daily tasks.
rows.ne: सुरक्षित नयाँ ठाउँमा पनि तपाईंलाई पुरानो घरको याद आउन सक्छ । आफूलाई समय दिनुहोस् । ठीक लागे, सँगै बस्ने मानिससँग ठाउँ र दैनिक काम बाँडफाँट गर्नेबारे कुरा गर्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Still waiting
rows.ne: अझै पर्खिँदै

rows.en: Not knowing what comes next is hard. Ask the person in charge of your shelter, or your ward office:
rows.ne: अब के हुन्छ भन्ने थाहा नहुनु गाह्रो हुन्छ । आफ्नो आश्रयस्थलको जिम्मेवार व्यक्ति वा वडा कार्यालयलाई सोध्नुहोस्:
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Not knowing what happens now is hard. Ask the responsible person of your shelter or the ward office:

rows.en: What is known?
rows.ne: के थाहा भइसकेको छ?

rows.en: What is not decided yet?
rows.ne: के अझै निर्णय भएको छैन?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): What has not yet been decided?

rows.en: When can I ask again?
rows.ne: म फेरि कहिले सोध्न सक्छु?
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): When can I ask again?

rows.en: You do not have to manage alone
rows.ne: तपाईंले एक्लै सबै सम्हाल्नुपर्दैन

rows.en: Choose what is possible for you today. If you need food, safe water, medicines or a place to stay, ask a worker to help you find support. If your medicines are lost or running out, ask a health worker how to continue them safely.
rows.ne: आज आफूले गर्न सक्ने कुरा छान्नुहोस् । खाना, सुरक्षित पानी, औषधि वा बस्ने ठाउँ चाहिएमा, सहयोग खोज्न कुनै कार्यकर्तालाई मद्दत माग्नुहोस् । तपाईंको औषधि हराएको वा सकिन लागेको छ भने, त्यसलाई सुरक्षित रूपमा कसरी निरन्तर राख्ने भनेर स्वास्थ्यकर्मीलाई सोध्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Choose what you can do today. If you need food, safe water, medicine or a place to stay, ask a worker for help to find support. If your medicine is lost or running out, ask a health worker how to continue it safely.

rows.en: Wherever you are staying
rows.ne: तपाईं जहाँ बसे पनि

rows.en: Home is more than a building
rows.ne: घर भनेको भवन मात्र होइन

rows.en: You may miss neighbours, work, familiar places and memories. These losses matter. Spend time with someone you trust, if you wish.
rows.ne: तपाईंलाई छिमेकी, काम, परिचित ठाउँ र सम्झनाहरूको याद आउन सक्छ । यी कुरा गुमाउनु सानो कुरा होइन । चाहनुहुन्छ भने आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिससँग समय बिताउनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Worried when it rains?
rows.ne: पानी पर्दा चिन्ता लाग्छ?

rows.en: Ask local responders about warnings and a safer place to go. If a warning comes, act on it straight away.
rows.ne: चेतावनी र जान सकिने सुरक्षित ठाउँबारे स्थानीय उद्धारकर्मीलाई सोध्नुहोस् । चेतावनी आएमा तुरुन्तै त्यसअनुसार गर्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask local responders about warnings and a safe place to go. If a warning comes, act on it immediately.

rows.en: Worried about money or work?
rows.ne: पैसा वा कामको चिन्ता छ?

rows.en: Ask your ward office what help you can apply for, what you need, and who can help you apply. Take someone you trust if it helps.
rows.ne: कुन सहयोगका लागि आवेदन दिन सकिन्छ, के-के चाहिन्छ, र आवेदन दिन कसले सघाउन सक्छ भनेर आफ्नो वडा कार्यालयमा सोध्नुहोस् । सजिलो हुन्छ भने आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई साथमा लैजानुहोस् ।

rows.en: Make time for children
rows.ne: बालबालिकाका लागि समय निकाल्नुहोस्

rows.en: Tell them what you know, and say when you do not know. Keep safe play and familiar routines. Do not punish children for being frightened or upset.
rows.ne: आफूलाई थाहा भएका कुरा बताउनुहोस्, र थाहा नभएको कुरा थाहा छैन भनेर भन्नुहोस् । सुरक्षित खेल र परिचित दिनचर्या कायम राख्नुहोस् । डराएकोमा वा दुःखी भएकोमा बालबालिकालाई सजाय नदिनुहोस् ।

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Feelings getting worse, not going away, or making daily life hard? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.
rows.ne: के तपाईंका भावना झन् गाह्रा हुँदैछन्, हटिरहेका छैनन्, वा दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेका छन्? स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । तपाईंले पर्खनुपर्दैन ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are your feelings becoming more difficult, not going away, or making daily life difficult? Talk to a health worker. You do not have to wait.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Help near you:
rows.ne: तपाईं नजिकैको सहयोग:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.

rows.en: Sources: WHO, Psychological First Aid: Guide for Field Workers (2011); IASC, Guidelines on MHPSS in Emergency Settings (2007), Action Sheets 8.1–8.2; IFRC Psychosocial Centre, Mental health and psychosocial impacts of flooding.

ch6.title: Chapter 6 · Care for helpers · Leaflet A4 tri-fold
ch6.source: Approved English leaflet r3 (exact text of the online and print versions) · Nepali machine draft r1, 14 Nov 2026, language and MHPSS review pending; every row needs a native reviewer

rows.en: FOR PEOPLE WHO HELP OTHERS
rows.ne: अरूलाई सहयोग गर्नेहरूका लागि

rows.en: Looking after yourself is part of looking after others
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नु पनि अरूको ख्याल राख्ने कामकै एउटा हिस्सा हो

rows.en: Helping people after a distressing experience is meaningful work, and it is also tiring. Stress is a common reaction among people who help others. You cannot take care of others for long if you do not take care of yourself.
rows.ne: पीडादायी अनुभवपछि मानिसलाई सहयोग गर्नु अर्थपूर्ण काम हो, तर यो थकाइलाग्दो पनि हुन्छ । अरूलाई सहयोग गर्नेहरूमा तनाव सामान्य प्रतिक्रिया हो । आफ्नो ख्याल नराखी तपाईंले लामो समयसम्म अरूको ख्याल राख्न सक्नुहुन्न ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Helping people after a distressing experience is meaningful work, but it is also tiring. Among those who help others stress is a common reaction. Without caring for yourself you cannot care for others for long.

rows.en: Every day
rows.ne: हरेक दिन

rows.en: Rest and sleep when you can, and eat regular meals
rows.ne: सकेसम्म आराम गर्नुहोस् र सुत्नुहोस्, अनि नियमित खाना खानुहोस्

rows.en: Take short breaks during the day
rows.ne: दिनभरि बीच-बीचमा छोटो विश्राम लिनुहोस्

rows.en: Keep in touch with family and friends
rows.ne: परिवार र साथीभाइसँग सम्पर्कमा रहनुहोस्

rows.en: Talk with a colleague or someone you trust for a few minutes each day
rows.ne: हरेक दिन केही मिनेट सहकर्मी वा आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिससँग कुरा गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Do something you enjoy or find meaningful
rows.ne: आफूलाई रमाइलो वा अर्थपूर्ण लाग्ने कुनै काम गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: Focus on what you can control; let go of what you cannot
rows.ne: आफूले नियन्त्रण गर्न सक्ने कुरामा ध्यान दिनुहोस्; नसक्ने कुरालाई छोडिदिनुहोस्

rows.en: Try slow breathing to calm down
rows.ne: मन शान्त पार्न बिस्तारै सास फेर्ने प्रयास गर्नुहोस्

rows.en: In the evening, notice one way you helped someone today
rows.ne: बेलुका, आज तपाईंले कसैलाई गरेको एउटा सहयोग सम्झनुहोस्

rows.en: Look out for each other
rows.ne: एकअर्काको अवस्थामा ध्यान दिनुहोस्

rows.en: Work in pairs where you can, and check on each other. Suggest a break when a colleague looks tired. New team members can be paired with someone more experienced.
rows.ne: सम्भव भएसम्म जोडी बनाएर काम गर्नुहोस्, र एकअर्काको हालखबर सोध्नुहोस् । सहकर्मी थाकेको देखिँदा विश्राम लिन सुझाव दिनुहोस् । टोलीका नयाँ सदस्यलाई बढी अनुभवी व्यक्तिसँग जोडी बनाउन सकिन्छ ।

rows.en: After a very difficult day or event
rows.ne: धेरै कठिन दिन वा घटनापछि

rows.en: Stay with a colleague who is upset. Listen without judging, and accept their feelings. Offer practical help: a quiet place, food, water, contact with their family. Nobody has to talk about what happened if they do not want to.
rows.ne: विचलित भएका सहकर्मीसँग रहनुहोस् । कुनै धारणा नबनाई सुन्नुहोस्, र उहाँका भावनालाई स्वीकार गर्नुहोस् । व्यावहारिक सहयोग दिनुहोस्: शान्त ठाउँ, खाना, पानी, परिवारसँग सम्पर्क । कसैले नचाहेमा के भयो भनेर कुरा गर्नैपर्छ भन्ने छैन ।

rows.en: Ways of coping that can make things worse
rows.ne: अवस्था झन् बिगार्न सक्ने सामना गर्ने तरिकाहरू

rows.en: Drinking more alcohol or using drugs
rows.ne: पहिलेभन्दा बढी रक्सी पिउने वा लागूपदार्थ प्रयोग गर्ने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Drinking more alcohol than before or using drugs

rows.en: Working without breaks or days off
rows.ne: विश्राम वा बिदा नलिई काम गरिरहने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Working on without breaks or leave days

rows.en: Keeping everything to yourself for a long time
rows.ne: लामो समयसम्म सबै कुरा मनमै राख्ने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Keeping everything in the mind for a long time

rows.en: For health workers: Self-care of health workers during floods and disasters (NHEICC).
rows.ne: स्वास्थ्यकर्मीहरूका लागि: बाढी तथा विपद्को बेला स्वास्थ्यकर्मीको स्वहेरचाह (NHEICC) ।

rows.en: Where to find support
rows.ne: सहयोग कहाँ पाउने

rows.en: Your supervisor or team leader · A colleague you trust · Staff support: ____________ (filled in locally)
rows.ne: तपाईंको सुपरभाइजर वा टोली नेता · आफूले विश्वास गर्ने सहकर्मी · कर्मचारी सहयोग: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरिने)
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Your supervisor or team leader · a colleague you trust · staff support: ____ (filled in locally)

rows.en: Signs of stress
rows.ne: तनावका सङ्केतहरू

rows.en: Headaches, tiredness, changes in sleep or appetite
rows.ne: टाउको दुख्ने, थकाइ लाग्ने, निद्रा वा भोकमा परिवर्तन आउने

rows.en: Fear, sadness, anger, or feeling numb
rows.ne: डर, दुःख, रिस, वा केही पनि महसुस नहुने

rows.en: Less motivation, trouble concentrating, using more alcohol or tobacco, pulling away from colleagues or family
rows.ne: काममा उत्साह कम हुने, ध्यान केन्द्रित गर्न गाह्रो हुने, पहिलेभन्दा बढी रक्सी वा सुर्ती प्रयोग गर्ने, सहकर्मी वा परिवारबाट टाढिने
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Less enthusiasm for work, hard to concentrate, using more alcohol or tobacco than before, drawing away from colleagues or family

rows.en: The person under stress is often the last to notice. Colleagues can help each other see it.
rows.ne: तनावमा परेको व्यक्ति प्रायः आफैँले सबैभन्दा पछि थाहा पाउँछ । सहकर्मीहरूले एकअर्कालाई यो देख्न सघाउन सक्छन् ।

rows.en: Ask for help early
rows.ne: समयमै सहयोग माग्नुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Ask for help in time.

rows.en: Stress getting worse, not going away, or making work and daily life hard? Talk to your supervisor or a health worker. Asking early is good practice.
rows.ne: के तनाव बढ्दैछ, कम भइरहेको छैन, वा काम र दैनिक जीवन कठिन बनाइरहेको छ? आफ्ना सुपरिवेक्षक वा स्वास्थ्यकर्मीसँग कुरा गर्नुहोस् । समयमै सहयोग माग्नु राम्रो अभ्यास हो ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Is stress increasing, not decreasing, or making work and daily life difficult? Talk to your supervisor or a health worker. Asking for help in time is good practice.

rows.en: Get help now
rows.ne: अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस्
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Get help right now.

rows.en: In danger, or thinking of harming yourself? Get help now. Ask a health worker or responder, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.
rows.ne: के तपाईं खतरामा हुनुहुन्छ, वा आफूलाई हानि पुर्‍याउने सोच आइरहेको छ? अहिले नै सहयोग लिनुहोस् । स्वास्थ्यकर्मी वा उद्धारकर्मीलाई सहयोग माग्नुहोस्, र आफूले विश्वास गर्ने मानिसलाई तपाईंसँगै बस्न भन्नुहोस् ।
rows.note: SAFETY row, machine draft: review first. Back-translation (machine): Are you in danger, or having thoughts of harming yourself? Get help right now. Ask a health worker or rescue worker for help, and ask someone you trust to stay with you.

rows.en: Support for staff and volunteers:
rows.ne: कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकहरूका लागि सहयोग:
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support for staff and volunteers:

rows.en: ____________ (filled in and checked locally)
rows.ne: ____________ (स्थानीय रूपमा भरेर जाँच गरिएको)

rows.en: Look after yourself. Look after each other.
rows.ne: आफ्नो ख्याल राख्नुहोस् । एकअर्काको ख्याल राख्नुहोस् ।

rows.en: Support is for everyone, including people with disabilities and older people. Ask for large print or more time.
rows.ne: सहयोग सबैका लागि हो, अपाङ्गता भएका व्यक्ति र ज्येष्ठ नागरिकका लागि पनि । ठूला अक्षर वा थप समय माग्न सक्नुहुन्छ ।
rows.note: Back-translation (machine): Support is for everyone, including persons with disabilities and older citizens. You may ask for large letters or more time.
